            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        本次实践主要围绕大体积设备日志的离线分析展开，使用 C 语言实现了两个轻量级日志统计工具。整体思路采用逐行读取、关键字匹配和状态机控制，适合处理 100MB 以上的大日志文件，能够在较低内存占用下完成事件统计和结果导出。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>--------------------------------------------------</p>
<p><em id="__mceDel">博客说明：基于 C 语言的大日志文件统计工具实践<br>--------------------------------------------------</em></p>
<p>一、项目背景</p>
<p>最近做了两个基于 C 语言的日志分析小工具，主要用于处理体积较大的设备日志文件，例如 100MB、150MB 甚至更大的日志。</p>
<p>这类日志如果一次性全部读入内存，不但占用资源，而且不利于后续扩展。因此整体实现采用了“逐行读取 + 关键字匹配 + 状态机统计”的方式。这样做的好处是：</p>
<p>1. 内存占用低<br>2. 适合处理大体积日志<br>3. 逻辑清晰，便于维护<br>4. 后续新增统计维度时更容易扩展</p>
<p>从日志内容可以看到，原始日志中同时包含本地时间和 UTC 时间，例如：<br>2026-05-08 18:40:41.580 | 2026-05-08 10:40:41.580 UTC | [main] ... [1]</p>
<p>这也为后续按时间维度做统计提供了基础。</p>
<p>二、工具一：Motion 事件链路统计</p>
<p>1. 功能目标</p>
<p>第一份代码用于分析 motion 事件在日志中的完整处理链路，并统计成功的 motion 录制次数。</p>
<p>主要关注的关键节点包括：</p>
<p>- motion wait start<br>- motion record start<br>- evr task create<br>- motion video upload start<br>- 上传成功日志中的 _av_x_1.nvt4s</p>
<p>其中最后一个节点最关键。</p>
<p>例如：<br>_av_9_1.nvt4s<br>表示第 10 个分片上传完成，并且 1 代表这是最后一个分片，也就是说整个 motion 视频上传完成。</p>
<p>如果是：<br>_av_9_0.nvt4s<br>则表示第 10 个分片上传完成，但整个视频还没有全部上传成功。</p>
<p>因此，只有识别到最后一个分片上传成功时，才将这一组 motion 计为一次真正的成功事件。</p>
<p>2. 为什么使用状态机</p>
<p>这些关键字不是孤立出现的，而是有严格顺序关系的。因此程序使用状态机来控制流程。</p>
<p>一个完整的成功链路通常是：</p>
<p>1. motion wait start<br>2. motion record start<br>3. evr task create<br>4. motion video upload start<br>5. put ... _av_x_1.nvt4s ... success</p>
<p>只有满足这种顺序，才算一组完整的成功记录。</p>
<p>如果出现如下情况：</p>
<p>motion wait start<br>之后紧接着出现<br>motion wait timeout</p>
<p>则说明本次 motion 录制超时失效，这一次不会被纳入统计。</p>
<p>3. 增加 mqtt payload 信息提取</p>
<p>后续又增加了一个新的关键日志节点：</p>
<p>mqtt payload[...] = {... "alarmId":"20260708230350" ...}</p>
<p>这个日志里包含两个非常重要的信息：</p>
<p>1. 该行日志本身对应的 UTC 时间<br>2. alarmId 的值</p>
<p>例如：<br>alarmId = 20260708230350</p>
<p>因此在最终输出结果中，除了记录 motion 各阶段的时间，还额外记录：</p>
<p>- mqtt payload 对应的 UTC 时间<br>- alarmId</p>
<p>这样后续排查问题时，可以更方便地把上传成功日志与业务事件关联起来。</p>
<p>4. 为什么按 alarmId 统计时间</p>
<p>最开始可以按上传完成时间来统计每天和每小时的次数，但这种方式并不总是准确，因为上传完成时间可能滞后于实际事件发生时间。</p>
<p>相比之下，alarmId 更接近 motion 事件的真实触发时间。</p>
<p>例如：<br>alarmId = 20260708230350</p>
<p>可以直接解析为：<br>- 日期：20260708<br>- 小时：2026070823</p>
<p>所以最终 CSV 统计改成按 alarmId 做时间划分，这样得到的每天、每小时分布更准确。</p>
<p>5. 输出结果设计</p>
<p>这份工具最终输出两类结果。</p>
<p>第一类是 TXT 文件，用来保存每一组成功事件的详细信息，例如：</p>
<p>- motion wait start 时间<br>- motion record start 时间<br>- evr task create 时间<br>- upload start 时间<br>- upload finish 时间<br>- mqtt payload UTC 时间<br>- alarmId<br>- 分片信息，例如 9_1</p>
<p>TXT 更适合单条问题排查和人工核对。</p>
<p>第二类是 CSV 文件，用来保存汇总统计信息，例如：</p>
<p>time_key,count<br>20260720,42<br>2026072010,5<br>2026072011,7<br>2026072012,8<br>20260721,11<br>2026072113,6<br>2026072114,3</p>
<p>其中：<br>- 8 位表示按天统计<br>- 10 位表示按小时统计</p>
<p>这样可以直接导入 Excel 或其他工具进行可视化分析。</p>
<p>三、工具二：统计 nv_xxx_main.log.gz 标题块出现次数</p>
<p>1. 功能目标</p>
<p>第二份代码的目标比较简单，主要用于统计日志中某种固定格式标题块出现的次数，例如：</p>
<p>----------------------------------<br>|  nv_1783779133066_main.log.gz  |<br>|    2026-07-11 14:12:13 UTC     |<br>----------------------------------</p>
<p>或者：</p>
<p>----------------------------------<br>|  nv_1783779297926_main.log.gz  |<br>|    2026-07-11 14:14:57 UTC     |<br>----------------------------------</p>
<p>这类标题块通常用于标识某个子日志文件或某段日志区间。</p>
<p>2. 统计条件</p>
<p>统计逻辑如下：</p>
<p>- 第二行必须包含 nv_<br>- 并且文件名格式满足 _main.log.gz<br>- 第三行时间需要落在指定范围内<br>- 例如：20260711 到 20260729</p>
<p>只要满足这些条件，就记为一次有效统计。</p>
<p>3. 输出方式</p>
<p>这一份工具只输出 TXT 文件，内容包括：</p>
<p>- 每个匹配到的标题块<br>- 最终总次数</p>
<p>例如：</p>
<p>Count 1:<br>----------------------------------<br>|  nv_1783779133066_main.log.gz  |<br>|    2026-07-11 14:12:13 UTC     |<br>----------------------------------</p>
<p>Count 2:<br>----------------------------------<br>|  nv_1783779297926_main.log.gz  |<br>|    2026-07-11 14:14:57 UTC     |<br>----------------------------------</p>
<p>Total count in range [20260711 ~ 20260729]: 2</p>
<p>四、实现思路总结</p>
<p>这两个工具虽然统计目标不同，但实现思路基本一致。</p>
<p>1. 逐行扫描日志</p>
<p>程序采用逐行读取方式处理日志，非常适合大文件。相比整文件读入内存，这种方式更节省资源，也更稳定。</p>
<p>2. 基于关键字匹配</p>
<p>通过 strstr、sscanf 等基础字符串处理方法，就可以完成大部分日志解析工作。</p>
<p>3. 状态机管理流程</p>
<p>对于像 motion 这种存在明确先后顺序的业务链路，使用状态机可以有效避免误匹配，也更容易扩展新的状态和节点。</p>
<p>4. 结果落盘输出</p>
<p>最终结果直接输出到日志所在目录下的 txt 或 csv 文件中，便于归档、分享和后续分析，也避免了控制台输出过多导致信息丢失的问题。</p>
<p>五、适用场景</p>
<p>这类工具适合以下场景：</p>
<p>- 设备端日志分析<br>- motion 事件成功率统计<br>- 视频上传链路排查<br>- 离线日志批量分析<br>- 嵌入式设备运行日志核查</p>
<p>另外，从日志中也能看到上传相关信息，例如上传过程日志中包含 curl 传输速率和耗时信息 [1]，这类内容后续也可以继续纳入统计范围，例如：</p>
<p>- 上传耗时统计<br>- 上传平均速度统计<br>- 上传失败率统计</p>
<p>六、总结</p>
<p>这两个小工具本质上都是围绕“日志结构化分析”来实现的。</p>
<p>一个主要解决复杂业务链路的统计问题；<br>另一个主要解决固定格式标题块的计数问题。</p>
<p>虽然实现上没有引入复杂框架，但对于嵌入式设备日志、边缘设备日志以及离线日志排查来说，这种“逐行扫描 + 关键字匹配 + 状态机”的实现方式通常已经足够高效，也足够实用。</p>
<p>后续如果需要，还可以继续扩展：</p>
<p>- 支持 gzip 日志直接读取<br>- 支持正则表达式匹配<br>- 支持多文件批量处理<br>- 支持输出更多报表格式<br>- 支持接入数据库或可视化平台</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">

        size_t base_len </span>= dot -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> filename;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (base_len &gt;= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span>)) base_len = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span>) - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        memcpy(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, filename, base_len);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span>[base_len] = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        snprintf(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span>), <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%s</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, filename);
    }

    snprintf(out_path, out_size, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%s%s_title_count.txt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, dir, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> main(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> argc, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">argv[]) {
    FILE </span>*fp =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NULL;
    FILE </span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span> =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NULL;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> line[MAX_LINE];
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> next1[MAX_LINE];
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> next2[MAX_LINE];
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> date8[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">16</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> out_path[MAX_PATH];

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> *start_date = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">20260711</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> *end_date   = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">20260729</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> add_stat(StatItem *stats, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> *stat_count, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">key) {

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> build_output_path(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> *log_path, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">suffix,
                              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">out_path, size_t out_size) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> *slash1 = strrchr(log_path, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (slash) {
        size_t dir_len </span>= slash - log_path + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (dir_len &gt;= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(dir)) dir_len = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(dir) - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

        dir[dir_len] </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (dot &amp;&amp; dot !=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> filename) {

        perror(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">open txt output failed</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        fclose(fp);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }

    csv_out </span>= fopen(csv_path, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">w</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">csv_out) {
        perror(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">open csv output failed</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        fclose(txt_out);
        fclose(fp);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }

    reset_group(</span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">current);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (fgets(line, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(line), fp)) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!extract_utc_time(line, utc, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(utc))) {
            strcpy(utc, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">UNKNOWN UTC</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 新增：缓存最近一条 mqtt payload 信息 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (strstr(line, KW_MQTT_PAYLOAD) &amp;&amp; strstr(line, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\"alarmId\":\"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> alarm_id[MAX_ALARMID] = {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">};
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (extract_alarm_id(line, alarm_id, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(alarm_id))) {
                strncpy(last_mqtt.utc_time, utc, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(last_mqtt.utc_time) - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                strncpy(last_mqtt.alarm_id, alarm_id, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(last_mqtt.alarm_id) - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                last_mqtt.valid </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (strstr(line, KW_WAIT_START)) {
            reset_group(</span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">current);
            strncpy(current.wait_start, utc, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(current.wait_start) - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            state </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> STATE_WAIT_STARTED;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (strstr(line, KW_WAIT_TIMEOUT)) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (state ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> STATE_WAIT_STARTED) {
                reset_group(</span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">current);
                state </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> STATE_IDLE;
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (strstr(line, KW_RECORD_START)) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (state ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> STATE_WAIT_STARTED) {
                strncpy(current.record_start, utc, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(current.record_start) - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                state </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> STATE_RECORD_STARTED;
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (strstr(line, KW_EVR_CREATE)) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (state ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> STATE_RECORD_STARTED) {
                strncpy(current.evr_create, utc, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(current.evr_create) - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                state </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> STATE_EVR_CREATED;
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (strstr(line, KW_UPLOAD_START)) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (state ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> STATE_EVR_CREATED) {
                strncpy(current.upload_start, utc, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(current.upload_start) - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                state </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> STATE_UPLOAD_STARTED;
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> ((state == STATE_EVR_CREATED || state == STATE_UPLOAD_STARTED) &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            strstr(line, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[uploading]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            strstr(line, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">put </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            strstr(line, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.nvt4s</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            strstr(line, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">success</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)) {

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x, y;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (extract_av_xy(line, &amp;x, &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">y)) {
                current.seg_index </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x;
                current.seg_last_flag </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> y;
                strncpy(current.upload_finish, utc, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(current.upload_finish) - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (y == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> day_key[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">32</span>], hour_key[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">32</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];

                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (last_mqtt.valid) {
                        strncpy(current.mqtt_payload_time, last_mqtt.utc_time,
                                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(current.mqtt_payload_time) - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                        strncpy(current.alarm_id, last_mqtt.alarm_id,
                                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(current.alarm_id) - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                    }

                    total_groups</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                    write_group(txt_out, </span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">current, total_groups);

                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (current.alarm_id[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>] &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                        extract_day_hour_from_alarmid(current.alarm_id,
                                                      day_key, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(day_key),
                                                      hour_key, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(hour_key))) {
                        add_stat(day_stats, </span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">day_count, day_key);
                        add_stat(hour_stats, </span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">hour_count, hour_key);
                    }

                    reset_group(</span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">current);
                    state </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> STATE_IDLE;
                }
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
    }

    fprintf(txt_out, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Total complete groups: %lld\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, total_groups);

    qsort(day_stats, day_count, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(StatItem), cmp_stats);
    qsort(hour_stats, hour_count, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(StatItem), cmp_stats);

    fprintf(csv_out, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">time_key,count\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; i &lt; day_count; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        fprintf(csv_out, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%s,%d\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, day_stats[i].key, day_stats[i].count);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> j = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; j &lt; hour_count; j++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (strncmp(hour_stats[j].key, day_stats[i].key, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>) == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                fprintf(csv_out, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%s,%d\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, hour_stats[j].key, hour_stats[j].count);
            }
        }
    }

    fclose(csv_out);
    fclose(txt_out);
    fclose(fp);

    printf(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Done.\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    printf(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TXT : %s\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, txt_path);
    printf(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CSV : %s\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, csv_path);
    printf(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Total complete groups: %lld\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, total_groups);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}</span></pre>
</div>
